headline: Contested Sectors Quickened Across the Front
war_summary: The latest returns show the fiercest movement concentrated in a handful of sectors, though several earlier flashpoints have slackened. WeatheredExpanseHex is again the liveliest field, recording forty-one strategic-base events in twenty-four hours and five in the newest two-hour window; its holdings remain divided, four Warden to five Colonial. FishermansRowHex has cooled sharply from the preceding edition’s burst, with two recent events and fifty-two on the day, yet still carries a mixed ledger of two Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral base. StlicanShelfHex has reached thirty-seven daily events, including six in six hours, while its five-Warden, three-Colonial split remains unchanged. MooringCountyHex is also active, with twenty-two daily events and three in the latest two hours, holding eleven Warden bases against one Colonial. FarranacCoastHex retains heavy casualty and enlistment rates but has quieted to three events in six hours and none in two. LinnMercyHex likewise shows eighteen daily events, though its recent fighting has subsided. Stonecradle remains divided at five Warden and four Colonial bases after twelve daily events.
